findings.claim: Goal D13's automatic startup deployment to OS skill directories is reduced to an on-demand doctor repair path, so a downstream plan can miss the required every-startup push and notice behavior.
findings.evidence: Goal D13 requires: "Copy (never symlink) each skill to `<home>/.agents/skills/<name>` and `<home>/.claude/skills/<name>` on every startup when absent or differing, with a visible non-modal notice while it runs." But build-001 says: "the-boss drives it through the repair path in cand-013 rather than reimplementing it," and cand-013 is only "One-click repair from the settings UI" routed to `doctor.mjs --fix copy-skills`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a separate analyzed candidate/work item for the startup deployment path: startup trigger, preference gate, full-pack skip, non-modal notice, absent/differing detection, and reuse of the mini copy implementation without making it only a manual repair.

findings.claim: Goal B6's required the-boss openspec submodule integration is not evaluated as its own candidate or work item.
findings.evidence: Goal B6 says: "The openspec fork is the exception and must be used... Submodule, not release artifact." The candidates include cand-008 for release workflows and cand-012 for "The mini vendors compass, rust-mcp-filesystem, openspec and sycophancy-correction as SOURCE," but there is no candidate whose gap/work_required is adding or wiring the openspec submodule in the-boss.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a candidate for the-boss consuming Prometheus-AGS/openspec as a submodule/build-dev dependency, including where it is referenced, how it is pinned, and what checks prove the Windows-fixed fork is used.

findings.claim: Several load-bearing adopt decisions rely on out-of-packet the-boss source claims that the packet itself marks as unverifiable.
findings.evidence: The artifact bases major recommendations on files such as `src/main/services/diagnostics/doctor/DoctorService.ts`, `src/shared/data/preference/preferenceSchemas.ts`, and `scripts/generate-cherry-assistant-knowledge/index.ts`, while `cited_paths` marks those paths as `MISSING`; the artifact also states: "that repository is outside the mini and therefore outside the review packet, so a reviewer cannot confirm them from the packet alone."
findings.suggested_fix: Include the relevant source excerpts/provenance for the-boss files in the packet or downgrade these to assumptions that the plan must re-verify before depending on them.
